rules.prepare:
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -O2 -g -Wall -D_REENTRANT"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update autoreconf -v -fi
sed -i 's@$(INSTALL) -T@$(INSTALL)@g' Makefile.in
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --enable-libgdbm-compat \ finish_cmds=""
echo "/* We use fcntl locking (POSIX) instead of flock (BSD) */" >> autoconf.h echo "#undef HAVE_FLOCK" >> autoconf.h
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make BINOWN="`whoami`" BINGRP="`whoami`" \ prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ infodir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/info" \ man3dir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/man/man3" \ install
ln -sf ndbm.h "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/gdbm-ndbm.h"
